translations.web: “Therefore don’t pray for this people. Don’t lift up a cry or prayer for them or make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.
translations.bsb: As for you, do not pray for these people, do not offer a plea or petition on their behalf, and do not beg Me, for I will not listen to you.
translations.kjv: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear
translations.asv: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me; for I will not hear thee.
